svg.aria-label: A single CodeCommit repository in the dev account, with each environment's own CodePipeline deployed into its own account; only the stg/prd pipelines' Source stage crosses accounts, by assuming a role in the dev account, triggered by push events the dev account forwards to each account's event bus.
svg.text: Only Source crosses accounts for stg/prd —
Test/Build/Deploy always run in the target account.
